advection_potential is headroom IF the air arrived unmodified. At light wind, transport over 100km takes many hours -- read this as a regional airmass ceiling, not a forecast. A POSITIVE dew_differential means the incoming air is MOISTER, which lowers the wet-bulb ceiling regardless of how warm it is.
